title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
description: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.

mainQuestExcel.title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
mainQuestExcel.description: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.

flow.stepDescription: Go to Gentry Maocai's residence and make inquiries

dialogs.text: You go first. No need to wait for me.
One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.

flow.stepDescription: Talk to the guards and make inquiries

dialogs.text: You go first. No need to wait for me.
One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.
Who goes there?
A Mondstadt merchant here for a meeting with Gentry Maocai.
Really? He didn't mention anything about a meeting...
The Master is dealing with some urgent business today. All prior appointments have been canceled.
Urgent business? ...What is it?
The Master has been working on a major business deal recently. He left early this morning to meet with a VIP client.
So where is he now?
I'm sorry, the Master has stressed that we must not disclose that information to just anyone...
"Just anyone"? Are you saying we are not his VIP clients?
N—No! I mean yes, yes you are! Ah... I—I meant no offense, please believe me...
Take me to Gentry Maocai or suffer the consequences!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Master is currently in business negotiations at Xinyue Kiosk!
I beg for your mercy! Please, my master will show me no leniency if he finds out...
Well, MY master has much more important things to do than talking to rude guards like you.
Luckily for you, your bad attitude will be the last thing on our minds when my master's busy negotiating a big business deal with your boss!
Th—Thank you, thank you! May your business forever be blessed by the Lord of Geo!
#Nice work, {NICKNAME}! Paimon never knew you were such a tough negotiator.
I was just bluffing.
Is that so? Now Paimon knows not to let your wily ways get the better of her in future!
Anyway, seems like the VIP client in question must be one of the Fatui.
I think you're right.
In that case, let's get ourselves over to the Xinyue Kiosk!
This could work in our favor.
You did great too.
Tee-hee! Paimon loves compliments and all... but treating Paimon to some tasty snacks would show that you really mean it!
Would you like to explain these extra fees you are incurring to your boss, or shall I?
#I'm {NICKNAME}, a VIP client of your boss'!
How strange, you're not on the guestlist...

flow.stepDescription: Go to Xinyue Kiosk and eavesdrop on Gentry Maocai

dialogs.text: You go first. No need to wait for me.
One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.
I'm sorry if my mistake earlier caused any offense...

flow.stepDescription: Eavesdrop on Gentry Maocai's conversation with the Fatui

dialogs.text: You go first. No need to wait for me.
One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.
I understand. I do. Please do not worry, you have my word that the order will be completed as promised.
Hmm... The subordinate I sent was not quite so optimistic in his appraisal. Is somebody being uncooperative?
Ah... We just ran into a minor procurement problem is all. We haven't managed to purchase the Cor Lapis yet.
But it's nothing for you to worry about. If Chang the Ninth won't sell, I can buy from someone else.
That would be most ideal. I remind you again that the Fatui care only about the result.
We are willing to lend a certain degree of support to this transaction. But if it is not completed in time...
You may suddenly find our good will comes at a price you cannot afford.
I understand... I am indebted to you for your protection. You know I would not dream of disappointing you, don't you?
We shall see when the time comes.
*sigh* Darn that old man Chang!
So, Mr. Gentry Maocai is colluding with the Fatui!
Who knows if Guhua Geek has made any progress. Should we go tell him?

flow.stepDescription: Inform Xingqiu of Gentry Maocai's plan

dialogs.text: Hmph! You said you had other things to look into, as if you're some sort of man of mystery...
When actually all you meant was you wanted somewhere new to park your backside while you read your book!
We know what Gentry Maocai's up to now.
I see. I guessed as much.
Did you really guess, or are you just saying that to sound clever?
The course of action we must take is now clear. To start with, please deliver this letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. They will know what to do.
My liege, for reasons that I cannot explain, I will be unable to join you.
There is no need for you to read the contents of the letter, when the time comes—
Whew, this writing is super hard to read! Paimon can't make heads or tails of it...
It's in an ancient script, perhaps?
Huh...
Hence why I said there's no need for you to read it...
The Feiyun Commerce Guild will have someone who can understand it.
But why do you wanna get them involved? They're one of the bigwig commerce guilds in Liyue — why would they wanna help us?
What is the Feiyun Commerce Guild?
Since we got to Liyue, Paimon keeps hearing people mention it. Seems they oversee a lot of business that goes on around here.
Having such big backing would be great and all... But are you sure they'd wanna help?
No need to worry about that. From what I know, they share my sense of chivalry.
Once they have read the carefully reasoned and passionately argued case I put forth in this letter, they will certainly be moved to action.
How can you be sure?
Gentry Maocai must be taught a lesson he will never forget. This is something we cannot do on our own.
Also, I do not wish for anyone else to know of my involvement in this.
Why not? You're only doing this to try and help Chang the Ninth, right?
"To silently disappear at the matter's conclusion, concealing one's name and contribution," this is the chivalrous thing to do. To savor the memory is ample reward.
Each droplet of kindness I receive I am duty-bound to repay with a welling spring of gratitude. I seek neither praise nor reward.
That sounds very lovely. But be honest — you just want them to do it so you can carry on reading your book, don't you?
Thank you in advance for delivering this letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Someone from the guild should be able to receive you near Liuli Pavilion.
Hey! Stop ignoring Paimon!
Why get them involved anyway?
A secret text that needs a cipher perhaps?
So how do we find out whether Gentry Maocai really is colluding with the Fatui or not?
We need to find a smoking gun.
So... shall we just go look for him? Best-case scenario, we'll catch him red-handed; if not, we can try threatening him and see if he squeals.
Let's speak to the guards first.
Okay, boss! Whatever you say, boss!
We need to catch him red-handed.
